description:
Bill of Materials for MockServer. Import this BOM into the dependencyManagement section
        of a consuming project to align every MockServer module (mockserver-core, mockserver-netty,
        mockserver-junit-jupiter, the Spring integrations, and the rest) to a single, mutually consistent
        version, so you can declare any MockServer artifact without repeating its version.

        This BOM manages ONLY MockServer's own org.mock-server artifacts. It deliberately does NOT pin the
        third-party libraries MockServer depends on internally (Jackson, Netty, Guava, Nimbus, Velocity,
        SLF4J, …), so importing it never changes the versions — or scopes — your project resolves for those
        shared libraries. Manage third-party versions yourself, or import each upstream project's own BOM.
